operation: content strategy: five rotating categories with performance tracking
owner_strategy: Rotate five viral formats across the two daily slots while keeping one recognizable visual identity; analyze performance to progressively favor the most effective formats.

categories.oddly_satisfying: Perfect cuts, seamless fits, clever mechanisms and satisfying transformations; precise, deliberate motion.
categories.surreal_impossible: Impossible scenes, miniature worlds and dreamlike visual illusions that stay coherent.
categories.hypnotic_visuals: Liquids, colors, symmetries and repetitive mesmerizing motion.
categories.ai_comedy_animals: Animals in human-like situations, gentle visual humor and surprising twists; family-friendly and kind.
categories.relaxing_magical_worlds: Miniature gardens, fantastical landscapes, nature and escape; a calm magical atmosphere.

implementation.rotation: deterministic round-robin keyed on (date, slot): two slots per day cycle through all five categories, anchored 2026-11-06; re-enqueues keep the same theme, so failed slots resume without category drift
implementation.shared_identity: every creative brief carries the shared TechnoInno identity sentence: one continuous scene, soft cinematic macro lighting, calming palette, realistic physics, no people, no cuts, no text
implementation.schedule_integration: tsu/jobs.py schedule_production now enqueues the category theme; tomorrow 2026-11-07 = hypnotic_visuals (12:00) and ai_comedy_animals (20:00)
implementation.performance_collection: tsu/performance.py collects view/like/comment counts for our public videos via the YouTube Data API every 6 hours (Beat task tsu.collect_performance), stored in the analytics table
implementation.report: python -m tsu.performance --report aggregates per category (videos, total/avg views, likes, comments), sorted by average views
implementation.legacy_videos: the two pre-strategy public videos report as uncategorized by design; no retro-tagging guessed

verification.tests: 186 passed, 0 skipped (4 new: rotation determinism/coverage, theme roundtrip, schedule integration, collect+report with fake fetch)
verification.deployment: api + worker + beat images rebuilt and recreated; rotation verified on the worker

future_decision: automatic weighting of slots toward top categories is intentionally deferred until roughly two weeks of per-category data exist; until then the rotation stays even and the report guides manual review
